function.name: submit_patches
function.description: Submit this round's router-bias candidates, most promising first. Each entry adds u units of 0.0001 to the correction bias of expert e in decoder layer l. Selection only: mixing weights keep the unbiased scores. Call it once per round.

notes.description: Notes for your next round, 100 words at most.

candidates.description: Exactly as many candidates as the user message states, most promising first.

hypothesis.description: One sentence: what this candidate tests.

u.description: Bias change in units of 0.0001. Nonzero.

function.name: expert_stats
function.description: Look up experts of one layer, from search-task tokens: base selection rate, risk difference inside each prompt condition, rate in the tokens before the tamper call, the honesty-instruction shift, the token-local map value, and the first-order dose curve (share of tokens where the expert is added or removed at 10, 30 and 100 units). Uses one of the round's 4 lookups.

function.name: footprint
function.description: Simulate a draft candidate at first order on search-task tokens: the share of token-layers whose chosen set of 8 experts changes, overall and per patched layer, with its norm and whether it fits the round's budget and footprint cap. Uses one of the round's 4 lookups.

function.name: pick_final
function.description: After the last round: name the one scored candidate of yours that you judge most likely to hold up on new tasks, and say why.

name.description: The assigned name of one of your scored candidates, such as beam_r03a.
